name: MORABO sofa with chaise facing the window, a loveseat by the stairs facing the play area
notes:
Alternative: Andrew's "chaise addon to sofa + love seat" (2026-10-25). No TV (F-65); the open side's walkway (y 143-173) stays clear (F-42).
The sofa (F-67, Andrew 2026-10-25: "a chaise, i.e. at least 3 seats", "empty space between like" the MORABO chaise add-on, "the largest sofa / sectional / chaise that can fit"): MORABO in Gunnared dark gray on 6 1/4" wood legs, the open base he linked, high enough for a robot vacuum. Its cover is fixed (vacuum and wipe, not washable); the same pieces in Grann/Bomstad leather wipe clean and hold no dust mites (F-66). Every sofa piece is delivery-path-unmeasured (F-22).
The sofa with its chaise floats on the walkway edge facing the window, and the loveseat along the railing's strip faces the play area, so whoever sits there watches Maddie. Five seats and the chaise.
loveseat-1 MORABO loveseat, rot 270, x 36-72.25, y 41.375-106.75: on the edge of the railing's 36" strip (F-40), facing east; its north end 35.4" from the heater face, the top landing's exit along the window, with nothing on the floor beside it (F-40, F-30); delivery-path-unmeasured (F-22).
sofa-1 MORABO sofa, rot 180, x 72.25-153.375, y 106.75-143: facing the window, its back on the walkway edge (F-42, F-39 30" behind it); delivery-path-unmeasured (F-22).
chaise-1 MORABO chaise add-on, rot 180, x 153.375-184.125, y 80.75-143: at the sofa's right end (its armrest moves to the chaise's outer side), the lounger toward the window, 74.75" from the heater face (F-33); delivery-path-unmeasured (F-22).
side-table-1 LACK side table, x 40-61.625, y 114-135.625, and plant-1 FEJKA beside it, x 62-71, y 125-134: in the corner the loveseat's end and the sofa's arm leave; the table is a drink table for both, with no lamp, since no wall near it can carry the cord.
coffee-table-1 VALNÄS, x 88.25-134.75, y 62.375-90.75: 16" from the loveseat and from the sofa, 18.6" from the chaise's side (F-39).
wall-lamp-3 VARPTROSS (top), on the window wall at x 50-57: the group's lamp. A floor lamp against that wall would narrow the top landing's exit beside the loveseat to 20" (F-40), so the light hangs on the wall; it is a soft glow (5.9 W), with the ceiling light for reading.
rug-1 TIOKRONA, x 52.5-170.5, y 29.5-123.5: under the VALNÄS and the front legs of the loveseat, the sofa and the chaise; STOPP FILT underlays.
Play area (F-61), as b staged it: the SMÅSTAD reading bench with the UPPLYST, two TROFAST (the second on the right-lower wall, x 258.1-275.5, y 96-132.6), the PJÄTTERYD, the VARPTROSS and the RÖDALM; rug-3 LEN moved to x 190-242, y 60-123, 5.9" clear of the chaise; kids-table-1 LÄTT on it, x 202-226.75, y 98-116.9, clear of both TROFASTs' 24" (F-32).
Walkways: the open side's walkway (F-42); the top landing's exit, 35.4" between the heater face and the loveseat (F-40), and the route along the window, 41.75" or more beyond (F-30); the play floor x 184-243 between the chaise and the TROFAST.
Not placed: the KIVIK sofa (rejected, F-67); the POÄNG; the LACK console and the STORSEGEL lamps (no wall for their cords); the TÅGARPs (the wall lamp lights the group, the play wall's lamps the corner); the TV (F-65).
Stairs: beyond the left wall behind a railing (F-40), so the 36" strip along it (x 0-36) stays clear its whole length, landings included; the bottom landing opens onto the open side's walkway, the top one onto the floor along the window (F-30). Which end people step off is unknown.
Heater: clearances run from the drawn 6" heater face (heater-depth-assumed): floor pieces from y 12, upholstery from y 18 (F-33). It runs the whole window wall, so the GINSTMOTT panels must stay off it: hem them to end above it once its height is known, or hang blinds as the office does. Window: eyeballed on the top wall (assumed-position:window); nothing stands under it (F-38).
Power: outlets can only be on the window wall and the play wall, and where they are isn't recorded; the VARPTROSS on the window wall needs an outlet there, and the UPPLYST and VARPTROSS cords on the play wall run down it in covers.
Kid safety (F-21): no glass; the TROFASTs are 20 1/2" tall, so nothing needs anchoring.
Extras: GINSTMOTT curtains x2 pairs, HUGAD rod x1, SVARTPOPPEL covers x2, VALLKRASSING covers x2, FJÄDRAR inserts x4, VALLKRASSING throw x1, STOPP FILT underlays x2.
Total $3,422.77, prices as of 2026-10-22 and 2026-10-23 and 2026-10-24 and 2026-10-25 (those before today are price-stale, F-02). Flags across the layout: delivery-path-unmeasured, assumed-position:window, heater-depth-assumed.
